title: Chandi Veeran
desc: Upon returning to his village, Paari strives to resolve the long-standing water conflict that claimed his father's life years ago.

title: Villain 2
desc: Ramu sets out to find his estranged brother, Rama, to reunite him with their mother. However, Ramu soon discovers that Rama is a mafia don, which makes it difficult for Ramu to approach his brother.

title: Sulthan
desc: Sultan, a motherless child, is raised by a group of criminals working for his father. However, when his father dies, he decides to reform the group into better people.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

title: Dhoni
desc: Inspired by Mahendra Singh Dhoni, a 14-year-old boy dreams of becoming a cricketer. However, his father, a government employee, has other plans.

title: Yevanda
desc: A young man working as a collection agent for a bank discovers that a couple are conning gullible people out of their money. He decides to give them a taste of their own medicine and falls in love.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Moodar Koodam
desc: Four strangers come together to rob the house of a wealthy man. However, when they reach his doorstep, they are taken aback to know that the man is bankrupt.

title: Theal
desc: A merciless debt collector confronts an unforeseen dilemma when a woman arrives in his life, asserting that she is his mother.

title: Pallandu Vazhga
desc: An old couple living with their grandson yearn for the love of their children, who live abroad and hardly visit them. The frustrated couple hatch a plan to make their children come home.

title: Subham
desc: The women of Bheemili are unusually transfixed by a soap opera serial. When three friends who run the cable in town decide to dig into the situation, they uncover unimaginable secrets.

title: Aaru Adi Bullet
desc: A young man is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.

title: Skanda
desc: A skilled martial artist's life changes when a secret agency recruits him to stop terrorists. He faces a dangerous mission that will test his abilities and courage beyond anything he is known.

title: Maamannan
desc: A father and his son must reconcile their differences and face their past in order to defeat a late politician's privileged son, who is out to humiliate them.
